newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to 0.05 lower.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to 0.05 lower.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open 0.05 cent weaker Thursday on follow-through selling by the funds, trading sources said.
The selling is expected to pressure the benchmark October contract through key support at 11.00 cents a lb. The next downside target was seen at 10.80 cents.
Wednesday, the benchmark contract closed down 0.19 cent at 11.05 cents, traded 11.26 to 11.03 cents. The rest of the board ended 0.10 to 0.14 cent weaker.
An estimated 24,933 lots changed hands on the day.
While further fund selling could come in early, the trade is expected to remain a stready scale-down buyer. Volume should be light ahead of the Independence Day holiday on Friday, however.

In London, white sugar futures were lower on Thursday after sharp losses overnight in New York. At 0845 EDT/1245 GMT, LIFFE August stood down $1.80 at $317.20, while the rest of the board was trading $1.00 to $0.20 weaker.
